items.title: When You Should—and Shouldn’t—Use AI to Search the Web
items.summary: Chatbots are often quite good at retrieving the information you want from the web. But sometimes you’ll get better results by typing your query into a good old search engine.
items.author: David Nield

items.title: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
items.summary: WIRED uncovered some 400 apps and websites linked to Chinese-language developers that look like regular AI tools but had secret features that let users create violent AI-generated images and video.
items.author: Matt Burgess
